name: URY desk awesomebar
describe: The Ctrl+K search modal over the desk shell: .navbar-modal-wrapper with the 28px .awesomebar-input-row, the 1px .modal-divider, the Awesomplete list and the keyboard-hint footer, on the 50% backdrop with shadow-2xl.
Open it from the navbar search button or the dock; frappe renders no group headings, so rows are mixed Go to (List/Workspace) and Report rows in score order.
